He was a disciple of Hemachandra Suri, the founder of the Digambara Terapanth sect of Jainism. Bitu is known for his extensive commentary on the Agama texts, which are the scriptures of the Digambara sect. His work, known as the 'Brahmavilasini', is considered an important contribution to Jain literature.
